items.title: Maersk is opening a 617,000-square-foot fulfillment hub in Hopedale
items.description: Maersk says its new $100 million Hopedale fulfillment hub will begin operations in late August 2026, create approximately 1,000 jobs, and support high-volume e-commerce fulfillment. The scale and near-term launch make this a strong operating-services signal, but no specific local vendor request is stated.

items.title: 42 North Dental is opening its new Boston home office on August 26
items.description: 42 North Dental is moving its home office from Waltham to the 16th floor of 99 Summer Street in Boston. The company lists August 26 as the date its new Hub will be open and ready for team members. The move creates a near-term workplace and facility-support signal, without evidence of a specific open purchasing request.

items.title: Whoop plans to roughly double its Kenmore Square headquarters footprint
items.description: Whoop plans to roughly double its Kenmore Square headquarters footprint. A large workplace expansion can create facility, IT, furniture, moving, security, and workplace-service demand, but no vendor request is stated.
why: Expansion can create multiple workplace vendor categories

items.title: Walmart won approval for a new Newton microfulfillment facility
items.description: Newton's Zoning Board of Appeals approved a variance allowing Walmart to move forward with an approximately 20,000-square-foot microfulfillment center in Auburndale. The project creates a future site-services signal rather than a confirmed vendor request.
why: Fulfillment operations can create recurring site-service needs

items.title: SMC is expanding its Devens medical-device manufacturing campus
items.description: Massachusetts awarded SMC $1.25 million to renovate its existing 330,000-square-foot Devens facility and construct a new 100,000-square-foot building. The project is expected to create 190 jobs and includes HVAC, power, injection-molding and building-system work. This is a strong expansion signal, not a confirmed open vendor request.
items.sourceName: Massachusetts Executive Office of Economic Development

items.title: Autonodyne is building an autonomy demonstration and training center in Boston
items.description: Massachusetts awarded Autonodyne $1 million for construction and equipment for a 6,500-square-foot Autonomy Advancement and Demonstration Center with simulator stations, secure collaboration space, IT systems, demonstration cockpits and training areas. The state says the company anticipates sourcing most project work from Massachusetts-based vendors.
why: Project includes IT, simulator and training infrastructure
Company anticipates sourcing most project work from Massachusetts vendors
items.sourceName: Massachusetts Executive Office of Economic Development

items.title: Helfrich Bros. plans a new 65,000-square-foot Lawrence manufacturing facility
items.description: Massachusetts awarded Helfrich Bros. $1 million to help acquire adjacent land and construct a new 65,000-square-foot manufacturing facility with cranes, welding equipment, an automated paint booth and a testing station. The project is expected to create at least 30 jobs and support local suppliers.
why: State announcement explicitly notes support for local suppliers
items.sourceName: Massachusetts Executive Office of Economic Development

items.title: Downeast Global Logistics is expanding into a 107,055-square-foot Taunton facility
items.business: Downeast Global Logistics LLC / SEKO Logistics
items.description: Downeast Global Logistics will occupy 107,055 square feet at 530 John Hancock Road beginning in August 2026 to expand its distribution operations. The move-in timing and warehouse scale create plausible facility and logistics-support needs, though no specific purchasing request is stated.

items.title: Panera signed a 102,000-square-foot lease for its new Weston headquarters
items.description: Panera signed a 12-year lease for 102,000 square feet at 133 Boston Post Road in Weston for a headquarters move planned for next year. The future move creates a substantial workplace-services signal, but there is no evidence of an open local vendor solicitation yet.
why: Large office move creates multiple vendor categories

items.title: Wonder opens in Millbury today and Brookline on August 27
items.description: Wonder's published regional expansion schedule lists a Millbury opening for August 20 and a Brookline opening for August 27. These food-service openings create near-term prospecting signals for recurring operating and facility vendors, although vendor demand is not confirmed.
why: One location opens today and another next week

items.title: Game Show Battle Rooms is opening at Burlington Mall on August 21
items.description: Game Show Battle Rooms announced that its Burlington Mall location is scheduled to open for business on August 21. The new customer-facing entertainment venue may create recurring local facility, event, security, and marketing needs, though no purchasing request is confirmed.
why: Specific opening date within one day
Recurring facility and event-service categories are plausible

items.title: Boston Dynamics is developing a 330,000-square-foot Waltham robotics center
items.description: Massachusetts says a $1.25 million Business Builds award will support renovation and buildout of approximately 330,000 square feet in Waltham for robotics manufacturing, training, R&D and related operations. The project supports plans for 650 new full-time jobs over three years.
why: 650 planned new jobs over three years
items.sourceName: Massachusetts Executive Office of Economic Development

items.title: CBSET is relocating and expanding into a 104,000-square-foot Waltham facility
items.description: Massachusetts awarded CBSET $1 million to support relocation from Lexington to Waltham and renovation of a 104,000-square-foot building with laboratories, procedure rooms, operating rooms, offices and upgraded building controls. The project is expected to create 75 jobs over three years.
items.sourceName: Massachusetts Executive Office of Economic Development

items.title: Entegris is upgrading its Billerica semiconductor manufacturing operation
items.description: Massachusetts awarded Entegris $500,000 to help purchase and install manufacturing, handling, cleaning, inspection and cleanroom equipment and make upgrades at its Billerica site to expand advanced filter production. This is a high-confidence equipment and facilities signal, not a confirmed open solicitation.
why: Existing 485-person workforce supports ongoing facility demand
items.sourceName: Massachusetts Executive Office of Economic Development

items.title: Field AI is expanding with a dedicated Cambridge robot testing center
items.business: Field AI / AI for Humanity Inc.
items.description: Massachusetts economic-development officials report that Field AI is expanding local R&D operations through a multi-phase investment that includes leasing a 20,000-to-25,000-square-foot facility for a dedicated robot testing and development center and creating 36 full-time jobs. Specific vendor needs have not been announced.
items.sourceName: Massachusetts Executive Office of Economic Development

items.title: Sky Nutro is investing $12 million to expand in Milford
items.description: Massachusetts economic-development officials report that Sky Nutro selected a Milford site after a multi-state search and plans a $12 million expansion that will create 120 jobs. The project creates a future facility, industrial, staffing and operating-services signal, though no specific purchasing request is stated.
items.sourceName: Massachusetts Executive Office of Economic Development

items.title: Avvio Ristorante is preparing a Worcester County opening in Millbury
items.description: Avvio Ristorante announced plans to open at The Shops at Blackstone Valley in early fall after shifting from an earlier summer target. The confirmed new restaurant location remains a useful pre-opening local-vendor signal, though the timing is less immediate and no purchasing request is stated.
why: Recurring food-service vendor categories are plausible
